svg.title: Heartbeat viewport contact fail-closed focus-scope scar
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing the existing Operator Overlay measuring live selected and keyboard-focused heartbeat controls, rejecting an offscreen selection as visible contact, choosing a visible keyboard-focused fallback, then refusing to restore from ambiguous empty heartbeat focus while the existing owner still lacks mutation-class and overlay-wide direct-focus evidence. Explicit policy can later grant rebuild amnesty only with both facts. Android runtime behavior and TalkBack accessibility focus remain unproven.
svg.text: WARM WALL / AMBIGUOUS EMPTY FOCUS FAILS CLOSED
LEGACY POLICY FAIL-CLOSED YES • EXPLICIT OWNER EVIDENCE NO • TALKBACK FOCUS UNCLAIMED • NOT PHONE DELIVERY
Semantic id survives; live geometry says it does not own contact.
Current owner + empty heartbeat focus → ◇ HOLD WALL / NO RESTORE. Missing evidence is not rebuild evidence.
Explicit overload + focus-destroying rebuild + no direct overlay focus → restore may be allowed.
Explicit overload + focus on STOP / Adam input / another overlay control → stale keyboard ticket dies.
No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Direct keyboard focus truth ≠ TalkBack accessibility focus. Safe refusal ≠ runtime proof.
No phone surface consumed. No second renderer hatched. Next seam: existing owner supplies mutation class + overlay-wide direct-focus presence.
